decisions.statement: A flag the shape does not declare is refused rather than admitted.
A refused flag close in spelling to a declared flag is answered with the declared flag named.
A flag declared boolean takes no value.
A flag declared required and left unsaid refuses the whole line.
A flag name is said on the line in kebab case and read back in camel case.
A line naming no single file, or no line this shape reads, is one file of none.

definition: the flags and positionals read off a command line against a declared shape
